senses.gloss:
आम्नाय m. (-यः)
 1. A Veda, or the Vedas in the aggregate.
 2. Received
doctrine, traditional and right.
 3. Traditional usage, family or
national customs.
 4. Advice, instruction in past and present
usage.
 5. A Tantra.
 6. An element of being, a property of sub-
stance.
 E. आङ् before म्रा to learn, to remember, घञ् and युक् affs.

आम्नायसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Pious, observing the Vedas and national
customs.
 E. आम्नाय and सारिन् who goes.
